as_written_in_papers.quote: All patients in our study underwent NOD2 (NM_022162) genetic analysis, which identified 8 different variants in 13 patients.

cases.statement: One person (P6) in a 13-patient single-centre Chinese cohort, carrying H496P together with a second NOD2 variant (c.1411C>T p.R471C). Sex and age are not stated for this person.

people.label: P6
people.zygosity_or_genotype: not reported (two NOD2 variants listed; phase not stated)
people.other_allele: second NOD2 variant c.1411C>T p.R471C, listed as inherited
people.key_phenotypes: bilateral glaucoma and cataracts; corneal deformity; phthisis bulbi; ichthyosiform and erythematous rash; polyarthritis with camptodactyly

quotes.quote: | P6 | c.1411C>T, p.R471C; / c.1487A>C, p.H496P | Inherited; / de novo | Benign (BA1+BS2+BP4+BP6); / Likely Pathogenic (PM1+PM2+PM5+PP3) | Bilateral glaucoma, cataracts / Corneal deformity / Phthisis bulbi | Ichthyosiform rash / Erythematous rash | Polyarthritis with camptodactyly | Not performed |
The variants p.R311W, p.R587C, p.M513T, and p.M491L were each identified in a single sporadic case, while one patient carried both p.R471C and p.H496P variants.

phenotype_specificity.statement: P6 has ocular disease with end-stage sequelae, ichthyosiform rash and polyarthritis with camptodactyly. Exome sequencing and the exclusion rule are stated for the cohort as a whole; no other-gene results are reported for P6.

quotes.quote: | P6 | c.1411C>T, p.R471C; / c.1487A>C, p.H496P | Inherited; / de novo | Benign (BA1+BS2+BP4+BP6); / Likely Pathogenic (PM1+PM2+PM5+PP3) | Bilateral glaucoma, cataracts / Corneal deformity / Phthisis bulbi | Ichthyosiform rash / Erythematous rash | Polyarthritis with camptodactyly | Not performed |
Whole-exome sequencing was performed in all cases.
Exclusion criteria were strictly limited to patients with other confirmed concomitant rheumatic or autoimmune diseases that mimic BS.

segregation.statement: No affected relatives are described. The co-occurring R471C is listed as inherited (from which parent is not stated in the text); H496P is listed as de novo. Pedigrees are referred to a supplementary figure not in the text.

quotes.quote: | P6 | c.1411C>T, p.R471C; / c.1487A>C, p.H496P | Inherited; / de novo | Benign (BA1+BS2+BP4+BP6); / Likely Pathogenic (PM1+PM2+PM5+PP3) | Bilateral glaucoma, cataracts / Corneal deformity / Phthisis bulbi | Ichthyosiform rash / Erythematous rash | Polyarthritis with camptodactyly | Not performed |

de_novo.statement: The authors state H496P has confirmed de novo status, with details in Table S2, which lists 'de novo'. Which relatives were tested is only given by the cohort-level method sentence; parentage confirmation is not reported.

quotes.quote: its confirmed de novo status (details provided in Supplementary Table S2)

| P6 | c.1411C>T, p.R471C; / c.1487A>C, p.H496P | Inherited; / de novo | Benign (BA1+BS2+BP4+BP6); / Likely Pathogenic (PM1+PM2+PM5+PP3) | Bilateral glaucoma, cataracts / Corneal deformity / Phthisis bulbi | Ichthyosiform rash / Erythematous rash | Polyarthritis with camptodactyly | Not performed |
Sanger sequencing was conducted in probands and available family members to confirm identified NOD2 variants.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense (His469Pro on NP_001357395.1; stated as p.H496P on NM_022162 numbering). The authors place it in the NACHT domain and cite another amino-acid change at the same codon (p.H496L) listed in the Infevers database.

quotes.quote: This classification is supported by the presence of a known pathogenic variant at the same codon (p.H496L) in the Infevers database, its location within the NACHT domain, and its confirmed de novo status

authors_classification.statement: Authors call H496P novel and classify it as Likely Pathogenic (PM1, PM2, PM5, PP3); the co-occurring R471C is classified Benign (BA1+BS2+BP4+BP6) in the same row.

quotes.quote: The novel variant p.H496P was classified as Likely Pathogenic according to ACMG guidelines (criteria: PM1, PM2, PM5, PP3).

| P6 | c.1411C>T, p.R471C; / c.1487A>C, p.H496P | Inherited; / de novo | Benign (BA1+BS2+BP4+BP6); / Likely Pathogenic (PM1+PM2+PM5+PP3) | Bilateral glaucoma, cataracts / Corneal deformity / Phthisis bulbi | Ichthyosiform rash / Erythematous rash | Polyarthritis with camptodactyly | Not performed |

concerns: Numbering: the paper uses NM_022162; the batch's NM_001370466.1 numbers are 81 nt / 27 codons lower (c.1487 -> c.1406; H496 -> H469). The stated c.1487A>C and p.H496P are consistent with each other on the paper's numbering.

A second NOD2 variant (c.1411C>T p.R471C, listed as inherited) is present in the same person; the authors' classification of it is under authors_classification. Phase of the two variants is not stated.
The variant appears only in summary and supplementary tables of a treatment cohort; there is no case narrative, sex or age for P6.
De novo status rests on a table cell and a supplementary pedigree figure not available as text.
The authors' criteria string includes population and in-silico criteria, but the paper gives no population figures or prediction scores for H496P.
notes_for_panel: Single-person evidence from PMID 41673771 (Table S2 and one results paragraph). The same codon change to Leu is cited by the authors from Infevers; the dossier does not verify that claim.
